visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A teenage girl with dark hair and bangs smiles enthusiastically into a handheld camera in a selfie shot. Behind her is a large blue transit bus parked at an outdoor station. A graphic text overlay in yellow reading 'Surprise' with star icons appears over her face. In the next moment, three other family members—two women and a man—lean into the frame, laughing and making peace signs in a bright, overcast outdoor setting. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor airport terminal with bright fluorescent lighting. A woman with short dark hair in a black mask walks through the terminal pulling a light gray suitcase while a younger girl follows with a teal backpack. Later, the woman is seen knitting a red yarn project while waiting. (3) Inside a modern airplane cabin, the scene captures the two female characters sitting in blue seats. One is sleeping with a white eye mask, while the other continues knitting the red project under soft overhead cabin lights. A digital map on a screen shows a flight trajectory over Europe. (4) A transition occurs to a high-altitude view through an airplane window showing a vast expanse of clouds illuminated by a warm sunrise. Then, a commercial airliner with blue markings is seen taxiing on a runway under a cloudy, gray sky. (5) In an airport food court, the woman opens a McDonald's 'Chicken' box to reveal two pieces of fried chicken, looking surprised with wide eyes. She is then seen sitting at a table with a white coffee cup, still knitting the red yarn while other travelers sit in the background. (6) The final phase shows the family in a parking garage walking toward a white SUV. The scene then cuts to a supermarket interior with green shelves containing sparse produce, followed by a transition between an empty white refrigerator and a refrigerator filled with various foods and drinks.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A young female voice enthusiastically shouts in Mandarin, expressing arrival. High-energy J-pop music with a prominent electronic bassline and driving drum beat enters immediately. A subtle 'pop' sound effect punctuates the transition. (2) The music continues as the main female voice provides casual narration about traveling with her companion. A faint 'thud' of luggage wheels and the rustling of plastic items can be heard under the mix. (3) On the airplane, the narration becomes slightly more hushed and intimate, describing the long flight. The BGM maintains a steady, upbeat tempo. A soft metallic 'clink' occurs as the camera pans. (4) The audio transitions with a 'whoosh' sound effect as the narrator describes the arrival in Holland. The music swells slightly in volume during the scenic shots, featuring a male Japanese vocal track. (5) In the food court, a sharp 'click' and 'pop' SFX are heard as the narrator reacts to the fast food. The environmental room tone is extremely low, with the BGM remaining the dominant layer. (6) The final sequence features rapid hard cuts in the audio, synchronized with the visual transitions. A final 'impact' SFX marks the switch from the empty to the full refrigerator, while the upbeat music fades out at the conclusion.
